task.title: Search every element in the project
task.problem: A search always started from one TARGET and its dependencies, so recipes that no aggregating target depends on were never searched.
task.proposal: Add --all-elements, which loads every element under the toplevel element path (as BuildStream lists them without default targets) instead of TARGET, applies --deps to each, and leaves junction elements out.
acceptance: --all-elements PATTERN and --all-elements --find GLOB need no TARGET; giving TARGET too is an error.
Elements no target depends on are searched; --deps none limits results to the project's own elements; junction elements' subproject trees are not searched as recipes.
It works with --all-options and --fetch-sources; searches with TARGET are unchanged.
evidence: test_all_elements_takes_the_only_positional_as_pattern, test_project_element_names_walk_the_element_path and the --all-elements runs in test_junctions_nested_fetch_strip_and_targets pass against BuildStream 2.8.1.

Review of 9df5155: junction targets are dropped before --fetch-sources, so an unused junction with no ref no longer aborts --all-elements --deps none --fetch-sources (unused.bst in the junction integration fixture).
